main.summary: Aggregates failures from command observer callbacks and retains the associated process result when available.
main.remarks: Thrown after command execution when one or more callbacks fail. The exception's aggregate inner exceptions contain the callback failures and can also include a process execution error. When the process produced a result, preserves its exit code and metadata for the delegator.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Initializes a new command observer exception with a process result and the failures encountered.
constructor.param: Process result associated with the callback failures, or null if no result is available.
Observer callback failures and any process execution failure to aggregate.

property.name: Result
property.summary: Gets the process result associated with this exception, if available.
property.returns: Process exit code and timing information, or null when execution did not produce a result.
